question_text: Estimate the amount of heat (in J) required to raise 2 kg of (a) $\alpha$-iron, (b) graphite, and (c) polypropylene from room temperature $\left(25^{\circ} \mathrm{C}\right)$ to $100^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. Give your answer as a tuple: (heat_alpha_iron, heat_graphite, heat_polypropylene).The units of each required answer are (J, J, J), respectively.
response:
Using \(Q = m c_p \Delta T\) with \(\Delta T = 75\ \text{K}\) and \(m = 2\ \text{kg}\):

- **α-iron:** \(c_p \approx 0.449\ \text{J g}^{-1}\text{K}^{-1}\Rightarrow Q \approx 67{,}350\ \text{J}\)
- **graphite:** \(c_p \approx 0.709\ \text{J g}^{-1}\text{K}^{-1}\Rightarrow Q \approx 106{,}350\ \text{J}\)
- **polypropylene:** \(c_p \approx 1.9\ \text{J g}^{-1}\text{K}^{-1}\Rightarrow Q \approx 285{,}000\ \text{J}\)

\[
\boxed{(67350,\ 106350,\ 285000)}
\]
